surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: User-supplied `filename` string and approved filesystem root `reports_root`.
TRUST: Host filesystem where `reports_root` resides; user input is untrusted.
SINK: Open and read UTF-8 text contents of a file resolved beneath `reports_root`.
GUARD: Resolve the combined path and enforce strict containment under `reports_root`; inspect every user-selected path component and reject the request if any is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root; verify the target is an ordinary file.
ORDER: 1) Join `filename` to `reports_root` and resolve to an absolute path. 2) Validate the resolved path remains strictly inside `reports_root`. 3) Check each user-selected path component for symlink status and reject if present. 4) Verify the target exists as an ordinary file. 5) Open in UTF-8 text mode and read contents.
EFFECT: Return file content as `str`. Propagate `FileNotFoundError` for a missing ordinary file. Raise `ValueError` on path escape, symlink encounter, or non-ordinary-file target.
END_PLAN
